summary: Frontend-only testing of LIVO Hungarian English-learning app. Verified onboarding → LiveRoom entry, bottom navigation (home/learn/progress/profile), Home hero + focus cards + homework toggle, Teacher sheet (pick + confirm), Practice view (8 modes render), Live room session-setup (duration selection dur-5..dur-60, session-start does NOT crash and shows graceful behavior since no mic), live-close + summary dismiss (Rendben), Learn tabs (words/lab/grammar/homework), Word Bank add/delete word roundtrip via /api/vocabulary, Word Lab AI generation (10 words for topic 'travel' via /api/game/topic), games enabled once >=4 words, Quick game opens/plays/closes, Progress cards + charts render, Profile selects (correction/hu/goal) persist. Zero JS console errors, no React crashes, teacher avatars load. UI renders as polished max-w-md phone frame.

issues: Clicking live-close during an active session shows summary modal — user must click 'Rendben' to fully exit. This is by design, but not documented via a data-testid on the summary dismiss button (only text-matched). Consider adding data-testid='summary-close' for reliable testing.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid='summary-close' on the summary modal dismiss button in LiveRoom.jsx for more reliable automated testing.

Optional: nav-live directly opens LiveRoom (via openLive) rather than routing to Practice view — the requirement wording suggested it opens the Practice/Live entry. Current UX is acceptable (Home 'Másik mód' or focus cards route to Practice), but consider making the center mic button navigate to Practice on tap and long-press for instant live.
critical_code_review_comments: views.jsx is ~420 lines and combines Home/Practice/Learn/WordBank/WordLab/Grammar/Homework/Progress/Profile — consider splitting into per-view files for maintainability.
LiveEngine.js is a large stateful class (~560 lines) doing WebRTC, timers, karaoke, summary — reasonable for the domain but could be split (transport / lesson-state / summary).
In App.js line 70, focus === 'Business English' check always resolves to 'business' regardless — dead ternary.
In Onboarding.finish() line 15, `path === 'guided' ? 'free' : 'free'` — dead ternary, both branches return 'free'.
All interactive elements have data-testid coverage — good.
seed_data_creation: None. Test word 'TESTword' was created and successfully deleted via UI during word-bank test. Word Lab generated 10 words for topic 'travel' (persisted transiently in engine state, not saved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App uses guest state persisted to backend via /api/profile, /api/vocabulary, /api/homework. Onboarding auto-shows on first visit and triggers openLive on finish. LiveRoom live-close during setup phase closes immediately; during active session it goes to summary — must dismiss via 'Rendben' button (no data-testid). Word Lab /api/game/topic is fast (~2-4s). Games gate on pack.length>=4.
